name: What kind of paint is best for kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen cabinets, durable, washable paints designed for high-traffic areas are essential. Alkyd or hybrid enamel paints are often recommended due to their excellent adhesion, hard finish, and resistance to chipping and scuffing. These paints provide a smooth, factory-like finish that can withstand the demands of a kitchen environment, including humidity, grease, and frequent cleaning. We primarily use high-quality, low-VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) options for safety and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable, washable alkyd or hybrid enamel paints are best for kitchen cabinets. They offer excellent adhesion, a hard finish, and resistance to chipping, suitable for the kitchen environment.
